digitization.sampling: Median of each RGB channel in a 5x5 pixel block centered at CSV x,y; nearest colorbar interior RGB by squared Euclidean RGB distance; linear interpolation between labelled 0 and 30 m/s tick positions; round final result to nearest 1 m/s
digitization.uncertainty_interpretation: Conservative approximate image reading tolerance; not a simulation confidence interval
digitization.limitations: Spot values of the displayed spatiotemporal average speed field, not roadwide vehicle mean speed, trip time, outflow or fuel. The 0 percent CAV panel is all HDV and cannot serve as a same-CAV pure NOA baseline. Unrounded color estimates are retained only for reproducibility, not numerical precision.

matlab_probe.probe_exit_status_note: Outer commands exit 0 because MATLAB try/catch records the dependency error. This does not mean SNOPT passed.

recommended_comparator_label: Cai-inspired centralized target assignment reference (local adaptation), not a full reproduction of Cai2024
